clue.text: See 9
Restaurant preserves distinctive character

indicators.note: the word Restaurant keeps a short run of letters inside it, as a jar preserves fruit

explanation.surface: An eatery manages to keep its special atmosphere.
explanation.definitionFit: An aura is the distinctive feeling or quality that surrounds a person or place.

clue.text: Vegetable in barge converted into fat

indicators.note: into says the rearranged letters go inside the word for fat

parts.note: suet is hard animal fat used in cooking

indicators.note: converted means the letters of barge are changed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone turns a canal boat into a vegetable-filled lump of fat, an absurd conversion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' turns BARGE into GARBE, which goes 'into' SUET.
explanation.definitionFit: This root crop is grown for its sugar content, so it is a vegetable by type.

clue.text: Shameful attempt to steal answer books

indicators.note: to steal means the attempt word takes the following letters into itself

parts.note: a shy is a try, as in a coconut shy
B is book, so BB is books

explanation.surface: It's a disgrace to try pinching the answer books.
explanation.definitionFit: Shabby behaviour is mean and dishonourable, so it is shameful conduct.

clue.text:
Dated term for 22 is retained in
 America

parts.note: the answer to 22 down is the word for principal

indicators.note: retained in means the little word is is held inside the abbreviation for America

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned word for principal survives in American usage.
explanation.walkthrough: '22' points to the answer of 22 down, used here as a piece of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaism is an old word or phrase no longer in ordinary use, an obsolete expression.

clue.text: Enlarge on treaty rewritten by legal official

indicators.note: rewritten means the letters of the three words are set down again in a new order

explanation.surface: A lawyer redrafts a treaty to expand on it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the chief law officer advising a government, so a senior legal official.

clue.text:
Cold fellow carrying lamp heading off
 to get good outer layer

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter of the lamp-bearer's name is dropped

parts.note: the pantomime hero with the magic lamp is Aladdin

explanation.surface: A chilly man with a lamp, minus its top, is going to get a good coat on.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'lamp' is the magic one: its carrier is ALADDIN, and 'heading off' leaves LADDIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Cladding is a covering fixed to the outside of a building or pipe, a protective outer skin.

clue.text: Ophelia prone to hog part of stage

indicators.note: to hog means the words keep a run of letters to themselves, buried across the gap

explanation.surface: The actress playing Ophelia tends to steal the limelight on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: The apron is the area of a theatre stage in front of the curtain, a section of it.

clue.text:
Delightful guest has no Italian vermouth for
 inspector

parts.note: super is informal for excellent or delightful

indicators.note: has no means the vermouth letters are removed from the guest word

parts.note: a visitor is a guest
It is short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: A charming guest declines the vermouth offered by an inspector.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for Italian vermouth comes from the old drink 'gin and It'.
explanation.definitionFit: A supervisor oversees and checks the work of others, much as an inspector does.

clue.text:
Prince ruling with father
 exploits awkward silences

parts.note: regnant describes a monarch currently reigning, so ruling
pa is an informal word for father
exploits as a verb means makes use of, so uses

explanation.surface: A prince reigning alongside his father takes advantage of uncomfortable lulls in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exploits' looks like a noun (deeds) but is the verb, giving USES.
explanation.definitionFit: Long meaningful gaps in speech that leave everyone uneasy are a stock phrase for such tense quiet moments.

clue.text:
Rude sailor visiting priest during period
 of sexual excitement

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a sailor

indicators.note: during means the priest is placed within the period

parts.note: the rut is the mating season of deer

explanation.surface: A crude sailor calls on a priest in the middle of the mating season.
explanation.definitionFit: An abrupt manner is curt and brusque, which comes across as rude.

clue.text: Reincarnated editor reborn as actor

indicators.note: reincarnated means the letters come back in another form, rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor returns in a new life as a film star.
explanation.definitionFit: He is the American film star of Taxi Driver and Raging Bull, so an actor by example.

clue.text:
Staunchly patriotic companion gets gold, plus
 French wine first

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order
Au is the chemical symbol for gold
vin is French for wine
1st written with I for 1 gives IST

explanation.surface: A patriot's friend wins gold and drinks French wine first.
explanation.walkthrough: CH is Companion of Honour, a British honour; 'first' is 1ST with the digit read as I.
explanation.definitionFit: A chauvinist holds an excessive, aggressive pride in their own country, fiercely nationalistic.

clue.text: Wild horse runs out into part of 21

indicators.note: wild means the remaining letters are thrown into disorder
out says the runs letter leaves the word horse

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A wild horse bolts and runs into part of a stopping device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runs out' takes R from HORSE, leaving HOSE; 'Wild' rearranges that.
explanation.definitionFit: A drum brake has curved shoes that press on the drum, so this is a component of one.

clue.text:
One German scientist contracted to meet
 another one and another

definitions.text:
One German scientist contracted to meet
 another one and another

indicators.note: to meet joins the shortened word to the next piece

parts.note: ein is German for one

indicators.note: contracted means the word scientist is shortened to its ends, as in an abbreviation

parts.note: taken as the full word before shortening
another German one is ein again

explanation.surface: A German scientist links up with one colleague after another.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a German scientist whose name splits into the German for one, twice, either side of a shortened word.
explanation.definitionFit: The physicist of relativity was German-born, and his surname means one stone in German.

clue.text:
Can containing hot and sticky
 what-d'you-call-it

indicators.note: containing means the can word holds the hot letter inside it

parts.note: a tin is a can
gummy means sticky

explanation.surface: A tin of something hot and gooey whose name escapes you.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are colloquial placeholder words for an object whose name you cannot recall.

clue.text: Accommodation for Swift in prison? About time!

parts.note: doing bird is British slang for serving time in prison
c is circa, about
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: Jonathan Swift jailed, and about time too.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital S makes Swift the writer; it is the bird. Doing BIRD is British slang for a prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A swift is a bird, and a cage is where a pet bird is housed.

clue.text: Girl nuts about stealing cattle

indicators.note: about means the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: A girl is crazy about cattle theft.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustling is the crime of taking livestock, especially cattle and horses.

clue.text: Seaweed turned into household implement

indicators.note: turned means the seaweed word is read the other way round

parts.note: nori is the seaweed used to wrap sushi

explanation.surface: Kelp has been transformed into a domestic gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothes iron is a common domestic appliance used for pressing laundry.

clue.text:
Winner of American beauty pageant getting
 partner

definitions.meaning: the US title-holder would be crowned ...
an informal word for a wife

explanation.surface: A beauty queen finds herself a husband.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an informal, jocular word for a man's wife, his partner.

clue.text: Lad combining moves in display of agility

indicators.note: moves means the letters shift into another order

explanation.surface: A boy combines his moves in a show of nimbleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Bending backwards under a lowering pole is a feat of flexibility and agility.

clue.text:
Device for stopping movement of barrel on
 slope

indicators.note: on in a down clue puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: rake is the slope of a stage or a mast

explanation.surface: Something to stop a barrel rolling down a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: A RAKE is the slope of a theatre stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A brake slows or halts a vehicle or machine, a mechanism for stopping motion.

clue.text: Principal ingredient of regular charcoal

indicators.note: ingredient of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The main component of ordinary charcoal.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means chief or leading, as in an arch rival.

clue.text: Fresh paint applied to a container for toys and sweets

indicators.note: fresh means the letters of paint are made anew in another order

explanation.surface: A new coat of paint goes on a toy-and-sweet box.
explanation.definitionFit: A piñata is a decorated papier-mâché figure filled with treats, broken open at parties.

clue.text:
Romeo with American mobile home crossing river to
 get to mountain in the Black Hills of Dakota

definitions.text: mountain in the Black Hills of Dakota

parts.note: Romeo is R in the radio alphabet
US means American

indicators.note: crossing has the shuffled letters straddle the river letter
mobile means the letters of home move about

explanation.surface: Romeo drives his American camper van over a river to reach a famous peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mobile' rearranges HOME, and 'crossing' puts R in it to give HMORE.
explanation.definitionFit: This South Dakota peak bears the carved faces of four US presidents.

clue.text:
Delicate embroidery originally attached to
 leather pants

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of embroidery
pants is British slang for rubbish, so the leather is in a terrible state and its letters are muddled

explanation.surface: Fine needlework is stitched onto leather trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' looks like trousers but is British slang for awful, signalling LEATHER rearranged into THEREAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means extremely light and airy, too fine for this world, hence delicate.

clue.text:
Farmer's tool chest broken with donkey's
 foot

indicators.note: with here means the donkey's letter is set among the broken chest letters
broken means the letters of chest are smashed and reassembled
foot is the bottom, so the final letter of the donkey word

explanation.surface: A farmer's tool box is smashed by a kick from a donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' turns CHEST into SCTHE, and the Y from 'donkey's foot' goes in 'with' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A scythe is a long curved blade on a pole used for mowing crops or grass.
